effect_description_eng:
When this card is trashed from the hand, if you have 5 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[On Play] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing 1 card in your hand, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. It can't unsuspend in their next unsuspend phase.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your hand is trashed from, this [Demon] or [Titan] trait Digimon may digivolve into [Titamon] or a [Titan] trait Digimon card in the trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
